title: Entropy of Resistor
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that the change in entropy of the resistor is zero.

title: Entropy of Universe
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the total change in entropy of the universe as 10^4 J/K.

title: Internal Energy Change
description: Essential Criteria: The student must determine the change in internal energy of the universe as 3 x 10^6 J.

title: Free Energy Change
description: Essential Criteria: The student must conclude that the change in Helmholtz free energy of the universe is zero.

title: Heat Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the heat generated by the resistor using I^2Rt.

title: Entropy Source Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly compute the increase in entropy of the heat source.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the calculations of energy and entropy.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any necessary factors in the entropy or energy equations.
